exact_scope: One nonempty full-dimensional rational polyhedron in its rational affine hull, actual REAL affine reference positive on each nonzero cell recession, continuous ordinary convex globally Lipschitz endpoint boundedly relative to that exact reference; finite REAL-PA uniform/global-decreasing cell approximants, exact any finiteQsamples before shifts, same actual cell recession. No global balanced-space gluing assertion.

proof_units.statement: Global polyhedral error bound from elementary nearest-point geometry.
proof_units.proof: Let sigma={x:A_j x<=b_j} be a nonempty full-dimensional closed rational polyhedron in its rational affine hull Q. Discard zero rows; set delta(x)=max(0,max_j(A_j x-b_j)). There is a finite H with dist(x,sigma)<=H delta(x) for every x in Q. Indeed the nearest point y exists by compactness in a sufficiently large ball. Put w=x-y. Squared-distance variation gives w·(z-y)<=0 for all z in sigma. The normal cone at y is the cone generated by its active row normals: otherwise separate w from that closed finite cone; a vector v with A_jv<=0 on every active row and w·v>0 would have y+tv feasible for sufficiently small t (inactive inequalities have strict slack), contradicting nearest distance. Finite-cone closedness follows by reducing each nonnegative representation to an independent subset and selecting one of finitely many subsets along a convergent sequence. For the same dependence-elimination reason write w=sum lambda_j A_j with lambda_j>=0 on an independent active subset. Its inverse on its column span bounds sum lambda_j<=H ||w||, with ONE H over all finitely many independent row subsets. Then ||w||^2=sum lambda_j(A_jx-b_j)<=delta(x)sum lambda_j<=H delta(x)||w||. Divide when w!=0; w=0 is immediate. Separation and Euclidean compactness are explicit ordinary foundations. This proves the error bound instead of importing Hoffman by name. Equalities of a lower-dimensional cell are removed by working in its rational affine hull.

proof_units.statement: A proper rational-carrier auxiliary reference agreeing exactly with the actual affine reference on the entire cell.
proof_units.proof: Fix the actual REAL affine ell(x)=a(x)+b on Q, with a(v)>0 for every nonzero v in rec(sigma). This is the original reference on this carrying cell. Put Gamma=ell+kappa delta with a positive integer kappa. It equals ell on ALL sigma. Its walls are rational because the common real affine ell is added AFTER the rational maximum delta; no irrational maximum wall is introduced. It is a genuine finite REAL PA function by rational coefficient-space scalar extension, and is ordinary convex. Its recession is h(v)=a(v)+kappa max(0,max_j A_jv). On the unit sphere, a is positive on its intersection with rec(sigma), a compact set; if that intersection is empty the second term is strictly positive on the whole sphere. In the nonempty case a remains positive on a neighborhood of that compact intersection. On its complement max(0,max_j A_jv) has a positive minimum. Choose integer kappa large enough to dominate the bounded negative part of a there. Thus h(v)>0 in EVERY nonzero ambient direction. No rational slope is substituted for actual a. A bounded cell is included (rec(sigma)={0}); dimension0 is handled by constants separately. This Gamma is an auxiliary full-space reference; restriction back to sigma retains the actual ell exactly. No claim is made that Gamma is the original reference on other cells.

proof_units.statement: Controlled exact whole-cell convex extension, using an explicit global Lipschitz hypothesis.
proof_units.proof: Suppose f is finite continuous convex on sigma, |f-ell|<=C there, and is globally L-Lipschitz on sigma in Euclidean distance. Choose a rational M>=L. Define fhat(x)=inf_{y in sigma}{f(y)+M||x-y||}. It is finite: the Lipschitz lower bound at a fixed y0 and triangle inequality bound it below by f(y0)-M||x-y0||; taking y0 gives an upper bound. The infimum need not be attained and attainment is not asserted. For x in sigma, Lipschitzness gives every candidate >=f(x), and y=x gives equality. The triangle inequality gives global M-Lipschitzness in x. For convexity, choose candidates within any epsilon at x and z, combine their points in convex sigma, use convexity of f and the norm, then let epsilon decrease to0. Hence fhat is finite continuous convex on all Q. At a nearest point y to x, f(y)<=ell(y)+C and |ell(y)-ell(x)|<=||a||dist(x,sigma), so fhat(x)<=ell(x)+C+(M+||a||)dist(x,sigma). By C1 choose integer kappa at least H(M+||a||), also large enough for C2. Then fhat<=Gamma+C globally. Set F=max(fhat,Gamma-C). This is finite continuous convex, Gamma-C<=F<=Gamma+C globally, and F=f on the ENTIRE unbounded sigma because f>=ell-C and Gamma=ell there. In particular Gamma and ell are not replacements on sigma. This is a non-PA extension used only to establish later approximation; no MA is assigned to F. The global Lipschitz hypothesis is explicit and has not been derived for every original balanced-space endpoint here.

proof_units.statement: Finite rational-position REAL-height global majorants, exact finite cell contacts, actual cell recession.
proof_units.proof: The complete full-affine majorization theorem proved in the whole S291 paper with BOTH source corrections and every reader clarification applies to F and the actual auxiliary Gamma: Q complete rational affine, Gamma finite continuous convex REAL PA on rational carrier and positive in every nonzero recession direction, |F-Gamma|<=C. For clarity its mechanism is reconstructed here. Gamma=max finitely many actual real affine forms; its support polytope Delta is compact with0 interior and possibly irrational vertices. F* is finite bounded exactly on Delta and infinite outside, by the bounded difference from the support function and separation. Finite LSC convex functions on a compact polytope are continuous on the WHOLE boundary: inactive inequalities at p give a fixed feasible ray radius r; for nearby feasible q extrapolate to p+r(q-p)/||q-p|| and apply the vertex upper bound and LSC. Continuity of F makes rational primal samples suffice in the conjugate supremum. Compact dual covering yields finitely many rational sample positions A with F*-eta<=max_{s in A}(p(s)-F(s))<=F* on all Delta. Append ANY finite rational B contained in sigma. Lift the ACTUAL real heights and add EXACT epi(h): E=conv{(s,F(s))}+epi(h). Gamma has rational carrying recession cones covering Q; h is linear on each, so epi(h) has rational spatial generating rays with their actual REAL lifted values plus the vertical ray. E is closed (compact hull plus closed cone), lies inside epi(F) by convexity and F(x+v)<=F(x)+h(v), and has finite attained lower fibers P_A. Its conjugate is exactly the sampled maximum on Delta, infinity outside; closed-convex double conjugation gives F<=P_A<=F+eta globally. At each retained s equality follows from its lifted point and the above bound. Lower graph faces project to hulls of subsets of rational samples plus cones of rational rays despite REAL heights. Their intersections are common faces: restrict an exposed graph functional to the affine graph over another face. Finite projections therefore give a rational carrying complex. Shared-face affine compatibility is a rational linear system; a rational basis and denominator clearing prove actual finite scalar-extension membership. Global ordinary convex supports imply all nonnegative-cycle primitive divisor positivity. The exact recession h is preserved, as the recession of compact hull plus cone is that cone. Restricting to sigma gives f<=P_A|sigma<=f+eta, EXACT values on every B, and on rec(sigma) the actual recession a because delta vanishes there. This is genuine finite rational-carrier REAL PA convex approximation on the cell. No finite numerical test substitutes for these continuum arguments; no source theorem outside the disclosed whole S291/ordinary foundations is silently imported.

proof_units.statement: Global decreasing approximation on one cell; exact scope of the remaining gluing problem.
proof_units.proof: Choose eta_n=2^-n and majorants P_n as in C4. On ALL sigma put G_n=P_n+4eta_n. Then4eta_n<=G_n-f<=5eta_n and G_{n+1}-f<=5eta_{n+1}=2.5eta_n<4eta_n. Thus G_n decreases globally and uniformly to f with unchanged actual cell recession and bounded difference from the same ell; each G_n has finite rational carrier. Exact finite interpolation belongs to the unshifted P_n, not shifted G_n. This result is for ONE carrying cell with convexity, positive actual affine recession and the EXPLICIT global Lipschitz hypothesis. Different cells receive different auxiliary full-space references; their restrictions are the original reference. Their PA values on a positive-dimensional common face need not agree, and local supports need not match after independent approximation. Adding finitely many contacts does not impose an arbitrary non-PA trace on an entire unbounded face. The theorem does NOT establish a global all-face compatible approximation on an arbitrary balanced support, derive global Lipschitzness for all such endpoints, or close original P05.1. The single-common-H constructions remain a separate route, not a simultaneous-distinct-faces theorem.
